AJ, saw Prove launch the Identity Platform as the trust layer for an agentic world, plus the ProveX exchange.

Launches that big surface more in-market accounts than reps can realistically touch, and that is where growth deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
AJ, quick follow-up for Prove.

After a platform launch, growth pipeline expectations usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap surfaces late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings your growth segment needs this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
AJ, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other identity-tech teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
